word: Title: Afternoon At The Community Event
I develop a small activity for the kids.
answer: "Desarrollo una actividad pequeña para los niños."

word: You create colorful signs for the tables. [pl]
We decide where to place the decorations.
They consider using more chairs.
I affect the schedule by moving one game.
answer: "Afecto el horario al mover un juego."

word: You accept the new plan. [sing, inf]
We claim everything is ready.
They add balloons to the entrance.
You increase the music volume a little. [sing, formal]
answer: "Aumenta un poco el volumen de la música."

word: We advance with the setup quickly.
I warn the group about the rain.
They download the playlist for the event.
answer: "Bajan la lista de reproducción para el evento."

word: You base your decorations on last year’s theme. [pl]
answer: "Basan sus decoraciones en el tema del año pasado."

word: We cause a small delay by moving tables.
answer: "Causamos un pequeño retraso al mover mesas."

word: They celebrate when everything looks nice.
I quote a line from the welcome speech.
answer: "Cito una línea del discurso de bienvenida."

word: You place the snacks on the main table. [sing, inf]
answer: "Colocas las botanas en la mesa principal."

word: We comment on how good the setup looks.
answer: "Comentamos lo bien que se ve todo."

word: They confirm the arrival of the volunteers.
You answer the coordinator’s message. [sing, formal]
I continue organizing the materials.
We check the sound system.
They run around helping everyone.
answer: "Corren por todos lados ayudando a todos."

word: You correspond with the sponsor about details. [pl]
I am going to add more chairs soon.
They are going to place signs outside.
We are going to celebrate after the event.
